cards.card_text: On the seventh day of the fifth month, Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard and a servant of the king of Babylon, enters the city.
cards.verse_text: On the seventh day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign over Babylon, Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, entered Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: With Jerusalem's walls down, what does Nebuzaradan do with the people left in the city?
cards.verse_text: Then Nebuzaradan captain of the guard carried into exile the people who remained in the city, along with the deserters who had defected to the king of Babylon and the rest of the population.

cards.card_text: Nebuzaradan doesn't take everyone to Babylon.
cards.verse_text: But Nebuzaradan left behind in the land of Judah some of the poor people who had no property, and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.

cards.card_text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had already given orders about him through Nebuzaradan.

cards.card_text: So Nebuzaradan, along with the other officials and captains of the king of Babylon, has Jeremiah brought out of the courtyard of the guard.
cards.verse_text: So Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, Nebushazban the Rabsaris, Nergal-sharezer the Rabmag, and all the captains of the king of Babylon had Jeremiah brought from the courtyard of the guard, and they turned him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to take him home.

cards.card_text: Nebuzaradan, Babylon's captain of the guard, finds him, and the man releases him at Ramah.
cards.verse_text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD after Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had released him at Ramah, having found him bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were being exiled to Babylon.

cards.card_text: Before Jeremiah turns to go, Nebuzaradan adds one more option.
cards.verse_text: But before Jeremiah turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, “Return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the cities of Judah, and stay with him among the people, or go anywhere else that seems right.” Then the captain of the guard gave him a ration and a gift and released him.

cards.card_text: He takes captive everyone left in Mizpah, the king's daughters included, the same people Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had put Gedaliah over.
cards.verse_text: Then Ishmael took captive all the remnant of the people of Mizpah—the daughters of the king along with all the others who remained in Mizpah—over whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam.
cards.snippet: …the king along with all the others who remained in Mizpah—over whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam.

cards.card_text: Men, women, children, the king's daughters, and everyone Nebuzaradan, Babylon's captain of the guard, had let stay with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the man the king of Babylon had appointed over the cities of Judah (Jeremiah 40:5).
cards.verse_text: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took the whole remnant of Judah, those who had returned to the land of Judah from all the nations to which they had been scattered, the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and everyone whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had allowed to remain with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as well as Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.
